section_summary: Pages 116–141 complete the October 1946 issue of the Bank of Japan’s Financial Statistics Monthly. Its tables cover banking, insurance, savings, securities, government bonds, prices and capital. Pages 142–153 begin the November 1946 issue, with its cover, contents, graph and opening banking tables.

people.name: Kitagawa Takeyuki
people.role: Named in the October issue’s printing and publication colophon; the precise function is unclear in the OCR.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, October 1946
subfiles.about: Monthly tables report the assets, liabilities and activity of Japan’s financial institutions and markets.
subfiles.summary: This section completes the October issue’s tables on banks, credit cooperatives, insurers, postal savings and the Deposit Bureau. It also records securities trading, Tokyo price indices, bond issues and redemptions, and planned and paid-up capital. Page 141 gives the issue’s printing and publication details.

subfiles.title: Financial Statistics Monthly, November 1946
subfiles.about: The November issue opens with its contents, a financial graph and tables on the Bank of Japan and other institutions.
subfiles.summary: The cover and bilingual contents introduce the November issue, followed by a graph of banknote circulation, deposits and loans. The opening tables give the Bank of Japan’s ten-day accounts and figures for financial institutions, including banks, insurers, the Deposit Bureau and agricultural credit bodies. Page 153 begins the detailed monthly report of all banks.
